meta.source: skyfield 1.54 Star rigorous space motion (position_au + velocity_au_per_d·Δt; no ephemeris, no network)
meta.convention: pmra=μα·cosδ, pmdec=μδ, mas/yr (ICRS J2000); rounded to 1 mas/yr, ra/dec to 0.001° (same as catalog)
meta.parallax: parallax_mas = 1000/dist_pc (HYG dist); unknown/non-positive dist → 100000 pc placeholder; rv missing → 0
notVerified: linear RA/Dec approximation ignores perspective acceleration (secular change of parallax/rv) and the cos(dec0)→cos(dec(t)) term; residual vs skyfield rigorous measured per case, worst recorded in meta
pm rounded to 1 mas/yr and ra/dec to 0.001° (catalog quantization, common to both anchors so it cancels in the residual)
HYG dist=100000 pc placeholder for unknown distance → parallax≈0.01 mas, perspective acceleration effectively suppressed for those stars
Barnard's/Kapteyn's (mag>7.5) are outside the rendered catalog and therefore not sampled; fastest rendered stars are Groombridge 1830 / Lacaille 9352
not for mas-level astrometry / precise pointing
